cut_contour.note: Proposal: the source has only a 0.25 pt hairline as die line, no ThruCut contour. Radius measured on the die line, to be confirmed by the printer.

reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of one sticker of the source sheet, cut out with 1.5 mm margin (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.
notes: Navy sticker, white text centred ('3 seconden' bold), arrow in a white disc. The arrow icon is the library atom with the colours swapped. Die line 0.5 pt. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
